description: What has an MCP server or A2A agent published over time? Pass a `url` or `name` to find its Observatory target_id, or a `target_id` for its dated facts: status history, manifest hash and bounded snapshot, conformance codes, metadata-signal rules (pattern present / not present) and the receipted change log. Facts observed at a time; not an assessment of safety or quality. Free, read-only, no account. Inputs must be public and non-personal; calling declares that (data_classification defaults to PUBLIC).
name: gaip_observatory_lookup
